description:
The surah that opens by proclaiming one of the names of the Day of Resurrection, **The Inevitable** reality or hour, so named because in the matter of truth shall forever be decided then and all truth shall prevail regarding every affair. It takes its name from the Inevitable or Besieger (al-Ḥāqqah) mentioned in verse 1. The surah describes punishment in this life (verse 4 ff.) and the next (verse 13 ff.). The bliss to be enjoyed by the believers is eloquently contrasted with the torments of hell (verse 19 ff.). From verse 38 onwards, God affirms the Truth of the Quran and the Prophet.
The surah is also known as Reality, The Catastrophe, The Concrete Reality, The Indubitable, The Inevitable Hour, The Inevitable Reality, The Sure Occurrence, The Sure Reality, The Undeniable

1.1: Or 'the Inevitable.' That is, the Day of Resurrection.

translations.3: What will show you what is the Besieger?!
translations.4: Thamūd and ʿĀd denied the Catastrophe.
translations.5: As for Thamūd, they were destroyed by the Cry.
translations.6:
And as for ʿĀd,
 they were destroyed by a fierce icy gale,
translations.7:
which He disposed against them
   for seven grueling<{["F", 1]}> nights and eight days,
 so that you could have seen the people
  lying about therein prostrate
   as if they were hollow trunks of palm trees.
translations.8: So do you see any trace of them?
translations.9:
Then brought Pharaoh and those who were before him,
 and the towns that were overturned,
  iniquity.
translations.10:
Then they disobeyed the apostle of their Lord,
  so He seized them with a terrible seizing.
translations.11:
Indeed when the Flood rose high,
 We carried you in a floating ark,
translations.12:
that We might make it a reminder for you,
  and that receptive ears might remember it.
translations.13: When the Trumpet is blown with a single blast
translations.14:
and the earth and the mountains are lifted
   and levelled with a single leveling,<{["F", 1]}>
translations.15: then, on that day, will the Imminent [Hour] befall<{["F", 1]}>
translations.16:
and the sky will be split open
    —for it will be frail that day—
translations.17:
and the angels will be all over it,
   and the Throne of _your_ Lord will be borne
    that day by eight [angels].
translations.18:
That day you will be exposed:
   none of your secrets will remain hidden.
translations.19:
As for him who is given his book in his right hand,
  he will say, 'Here, take and read my book!
translations.20: Indeed I knew that I shall encounter my account.'
translations.21: So he will have a pleasant life,
translations.23: whose clusters [of fruits] will be within easy reach.
translations.24:
[He will be told]: 'Enjoy your food and drink,
  for what you had sent in advance in past days.'
translations.25:
But as for him who is given his book in his left hand,
 he will say, 'I wish I had not been given my book,
translations.26: nor had I ever known what my account is!
translations.27: I wish death had been the end of it all!
translations.28: My wealth did not avail me.
translations.29: My authority has departed from me.'
translations.30: [The angels will be told:] 'Seize him, and fetter him!
translations.32:
Then, in a chain whose length is seventy cubits,
   bind him.
translations.33: Indeed he had no faith in Allah, the All-supreme,
translations.34: and he did not urge the feeding of the needy,
translations.35: so he has no friend here today,
translations.37: which no one shall eat except the iniquitous.'
translations.38: I swear by what you see
translations.39: and what you do not see:
translations.40: it is indeed the speech of a noble apostle,
translations.41:
and it is not the speech of a poet.
 Little is the faith that you have!
translations.42:
Nor is it the speech of a soothsayer.
 Little is the admonition that you take!
translations.43: Gradually sent down from the Lord of all the worlds.
translations.44: Had he faked any sayings in Our name,
translations.45: We would have surely seized him by the right hand
translations.46: and then cut off his aorta,
translations.47: and none of you could have held Us off from him.
translations.48: Indeed it is a reminder for the Godwary.
translations.49:
Indeed We know
   that there are some among you who deny [it].
translations.50:
And indeed it will be a [matter of] regret
   for the faithless.
translations.52: So _celebrate_ the Name of _your_ Lord, the All-supreme.
